subject: storytime
title: Biscuit words
about: Biscuit is a small yellow puppy who is not ready for bed and keeps asking for one more thing, from a snack to a story to a goodnight hug. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together at bedtime, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Alyssa Satin Capucilli
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A sleepy-time puppy who would rather have a snack, a drink and a story than go to bed.

cards.note: capital B, it is his name; two parts: Bis-cuit; ui just says short i: Bis-kit
pp is one p; y at the end says ee: pup-ee
s-n blend; ck is one sound
d-r blend; n-k at the end
ss is two letters, one sound: s
b-l blend; two parts: blan + ket
s-t blend; or says or; y at the end says ee: stor-ee
s-l blend; ee says long e
oo says long oo, like in moon
magic e makes i say its name
oo says the short oo, like in book
a says aw before ll; ll is one sound: bawl
a says o after w: wonts
igh says long i, like in light
